frozen_before: any Random Forest / XGBoost / survival fit; Stage 2B models are re-scored under this framework but not re-tuned

long_duration.definition: duration_days > 365 (more than one year from first tender publication to contract signing)
long_duration.business_rationale: A one-year advertisement-to-signing horizon is a common planning yardstick and a clear alert for procurement officers.
long_duration.disclosure: Stage 2A reported that 45 of the 353 validation contracts exceed 365 days. That count was known when the threshold was chosen; no model performance on validation was.

long_duration_score.B1: training share of contracts > 365 days in the same method x category cell (fallback method -> category -> global, as for B1 medians)
long_duration_score.regression_models: P(duration > 365) = 1 - Phi((ln 365 - yhat_log) / sigma), sigma = std of the model's out-of-fold training log residuals (5-fold project-grouped CV)

alert_rules.primary: alert if score >= t; t chosen on the model's own training out-of-fold scores to maximise F1 subject to an alert rate <= 30%; ties -> higher t. Never adjusted on validation.
alert_rules.secondary_fixed: alert if the point prediction exp(yhat) > 365 days (no tuning)
alert_rules.capacity_view: recall and precision when the top 20% of validation scores are flagged (rank-only, no tuning)

training_protocols.asof: REFERENCE. Training-period labels signed on/before 2022-06-30 (462 rows).
training_protocols.cfw365: ALTERNATIVE, complete-follow-up window: as-of 2022-06-30 AND first tender on/before 2021-06-30 (372 rows). Disclosure: this window was first examined post hoc in Stage 2B (as 'asof_fu365') after primary validation results were seen. It is now frozen; no other window will be tried. It still drops tenders from that window that signed more than 365 days after their publication if that is after the cutoff, so it is not free of selection bias.

validation: the same 353 Stage 2A validation contracts for every model and protocol; test set (616) unscored

experiment_budget.random_forest: grid of 36: max_depth {4, 6, 10, None} x min_samples_leaf {5, 10, 20} x max_features {0.3, 0.6, 1.0}; n_estimators 500; seed 20261025
experiment_budget.xgboost: 30 random configurations (seed 20261025) over max_depth {2,3,4}, learning_rate {0.03,0.05,0.1}, min_child_weight {5,10,20}, subsample {0.7,0.9}, colsample_bytree {0.5,0.8}, reg_lambda {1,5,10}, reg_alpha {0,0.5}; n_estimators by training-only grouped-CV early stopping (max 1000, patience 50)
experiment_budget.selection_metric_in_cv: MAE in days of exp(yhat), 5-fold GroupKFold by project on training rows

model_selection_rule: Prefer the simplest model whose validation MAE is within the project-cluster bootstrap CI of the best and whose paired MAE reduction vs B1 is reliable (package and project clusters), considering long-duration recall at the primary alert rule, long-contract bias, unseen-project performance and interpretability. Recall alone never decides.
